doctrine: Discover latent connections reality is already trying to form; treat mature organized exchanges as counterevidence and scan their residuals rather than inventing adjacent markets.

connection_pressure: Xuzhou publicly operates opportunity and capability lists rather than relying only on abstract policy.
The 2026 first batch contains 50 opportunity scenes and 72 capability scenes.
The city reports 285 scene projects landed over the previous year.
Technology managers already translate fuzzy enterprise pain into structured technical requirements and match experts.
counterevidence: The city already has an explicit matching mechanism, so generic scene matching is not a missing edge.
Nearly 1000 technology managers and established expert/result databases already handle part of the translation layer.
findings.residual_question: Which opportunity-list items remain unmatched, delayed, repeatedly re-scoped, or dependent on manual translation after the existing scene/technology-manager machinery is used?
findings.next_truth: Obtain a current public scene-opportunity/capability list or aggregate status and identify stale/unmatched/slow items. Do not contact random enterprises before a residual item is visible.
findings.promotion_gate: Repeated residual class with a visible missing edge after current public/technology-manager routes.

connection_pressure: Jiangsu is driving AI+manufacturing diagnosis toward near-universal coverage for above-scale industrial enterprises by 2027.
The official design explicitly says diagnose while building and use diagnosis to promote construction.
The province is building diagnostic service-provider pools and explicitly encourages frontline deployment engineer teams.
counterevidence: Consulting, diagnosis, design, financing, transformation and hosting are explicitly encouraged as one-stop integrated services.
A generic diagnosis-to-implementation intermediary would duplicate a policy-backed market already forming.
findings.residual_question: After an official/qualified diagnosis, are there repeated bounded implementation tasks that are too small or operationally awkward for the primary provider but still materially block adoption?
findings.next_truth: Only reopen on a post-diagnosis residual packet from a real enterprise or service provider; do not sell generic AI consulting.

connection_pressure: Xuzhou Data Regulation took effect 2026-07-01 and explicitly supports data compliance, security audit, risk assessment and low-cost data-hosting services for SMEs.
Xuzhou reports more than 1.5 million market entities, while the existing industrial-chain legal-service system has 44 direct service stations focused on key enterprises.
Local public analysis identifies limited SME/microbusiness coverage and relative shortage of professional talent for digital-economy/AI legal needs.
counterevidence: Xuzhou already has 17 industrial-chain legal-service alliances and a digital legal-service platform with lawyers and enterprise users.
Policy support alone does not prove an SME will pay for a micro data-compliance task.
findings.residual_question: Do smaller firms repeatedly face bounded data/AI compliance or security decisions below the economics of a retained law firm or full consulting engagement?
findings.next_truth: Find direct SME examples of a recent data/AI use case delayed, rejected or reworked because authorization, personal information, data-cross-border, security classification or model-data provenance was unclear; capture workaround, cost and decision impact.

connection_pressure: Xuzhou 12345 handled 17,201 enterprise requests in 2025.
The Xuzhou comprehensive enterprise-service platform currently reports more than 20,000 processed requests and more than 310,000 registered users.
counterevidence: Raw request counts do not identify commercial unmet demand, repeated residuals, payer or missing capability.
The platform already routes many policy and administrative requests.
findings.residual_question: Which non-sensitive enterprise request categories recur after administrative/policy answers and remain unresolved because a private execution capability is missing or badly routed?
findings.next_truth: Seek aggregate categories/closure reasons, not company-level complaint data; use the ledger as a sensor, not a marketplace thesis.

connection_pressure: Local technology managers explicitly turn enterprise problems that firms cannot articulate into structured technical requirements.
Xuzhou reports nearly 1000 certified technology managers and a citywide recurring demand-mining mechanism.
One technology-manager office reported eight technology contracts worth nearly RMB 2 million in 2024.
findings.decision: Do not build a generic enterprise-problem-to-expert matching layer. Mine its residual queue, failures, time-to-match and classes that fall below institutional project economics.

connection_pressure: Xuzhou has more than 2.2998 million registered residents aged 60+ and explicitly identifies medical accompaniment as a pressing family need.
counterevidence: The city has launched a five-district pilot with standardized training, certification, a city-level escort-worker registry, smart养老 platform order dispatch and supervision.
Generic elder medical escort is therefore already being organized end-to-end.
findings.reopen_only_if: A repeated after-visit/family coordination or county coverage residual appears outside the training-certification-dispatch loop.

connection_pressure: Xuzhou's 2026 subsidized training catalog includes 525 skill-level items, 74 special abilities and 174 shortage occupations.
counterevidence: Order-based and project-based training already exists, and providers receive additional subsidy preference when stable employment exceeds 50%.
Generic training-to-job matching is therefore not a missing edge.
findings.reopen_only_if: A specific skill class shows repeated certification without callable task evidence and employers use costly workarounds to verify ability.

connection_pressure: Xuzhou Industrial Park reports cumulative activation of 1,018 mu of idle land and more than 150,000 square meters of standard factory space.
One 80-mu / 40,000+ square-meter asset required repeated negotiation and cross-department coordination before reuse.
counterevidence: Debt, title and historical liabilities dominate the missing edge, making the route high-permission and legally complex.
Government/park coordination is already the natural orchestrator for many cases.

connection_pressure: Industrial byproducts and waste are real resource flows.
counterevidence: Xuzhou reports industrial solid-waste utilization around/above 95%, 8.198 million tonnes annual recycling, digital full-chain tracking and large dedicated resource-utilization bases.
findings.decision: Do not reopen generic waste-to-resource matching. Only consider a specific residual material whose outlet is demonstrably missing.

connection_pressure: A specialized cat-litter cloud warehouse launched in April 2026 and gathered 30+ firms with nearly 300,000 shipments in under three months.
XCMG and local SMEs already operate shared intelligent-welding capacity.
Fengxian's 1400+ electric-tricycle/parts cluster is building dedicated component testing and trusted data-space infrastructure.
findings.interpretation: Shared specialized infrastructure is a naturally forming connection pattern in dense local clusters. The engine should scan other clusters for repeated fixed-cost capabilities that firms are already informally sharing but that have not yet become a formal shared node.
findings.next_truth: Compare glass, board/furniture, pet products, agricultural processing and other clusters for shared-but-informal inspection, packaging, localization, certification, after-sales, tooling or data capabilities. Promote only where partial sharing already exists.
